limitations: The gateway and all capacities are synthetic software-verification values.
Measurement publication ends at an implementation-neutral boundary and does not traverse a BAN.
Commands originate at the boundary; authentication, authorization, safety policy, and an external station are not modeled.
A delivered control message does not yet execute a physiological or payload actuation effect.
